title: Incident response with an AI co-pilot
summary: During an attack, an agent follows the playbook, runs the investigation and keeps the timeline while people make the calls.

steps.label: open incident
steps.title: Start the playbook
steps.text: SOAR playbooks turn response plans into steps. The agent handles the parts that need judgement and summarising.

steps.label: hunt
steps.title: Scope the blast radius
steps.text: The agent writes and runs log queries: what did this account do since the suspicious login?
payload: sign-ins + mailbox rules + file access, last 72h
new forwarding rule to an outside address
Attackers use this to keep reading email.

steps.label: propose containment
steps.title: Propose, don't just do
steps.text: Disabling a CFO's account during a deal is a business decision. Destructive or disruptive steps wait for approval.
payload: revoke sessions · reset password · remove forwarding rule · require new MFA

steps.label: timeline + report
steps.title: Document as you go
steps.text: The agent keeps a timestamped timeline of every finding and action, then drafts the post-incident report and lessons learned.
payload: check other accounts for the same rule · train finance team
